visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized graphic '起來!' followed by a man with a messy black wig and a blue hoodie sitting in a dimly lit indoor space, reacting with wide-eyed shock and raised hands. He wears a yellow shirt underneath. Blue sci-fi interface overlays appear in front of him, showing text and symbols. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor park during daylight with green trees in the background. The man is performing various exercises: spinning yellow and red fitness wheels, attempting pull-ups on a metal bar, and doing a rhythmic dance move. Large white numeric overlays count up from 20/100 to 100/100 as he completes tasks. (3) The man enters a restaurant called '肉次方' (Power of Meat) which has warm interior lighting and wooden wall panels. A staff member wearing glasses and an orange-white checkered uniform jacket greets him. The man sits at a table equipped with a built-in charcoal grill. (4) Close-up shots show a large, raw ribeye steak being sliced by hands wearing blue gloves, then seasoned with salt. The man uses metal tongs to grill the steak over an open flame, adding pieces of onion and pork fat to the mesh. Yellow captions emphasizing 'Super Large Piece' appear on screen. (5) After cooking, the man uses scissors to cut the steak into smaller pieces. He dips a piece into a sauce and eats it, closing his eyes in satisfaction. More UI overlays appear, rewarding him with 'A5 Wagyu'. (6) The final phase is a montage of various dishes including hot pots, bibimbap, and desserts like ice cream. The man continues to eat enthusiastically, gesturing towards his arm muscles and pointing at the camera as the video concludes with promotional text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, percussive impact SFX followed by a high-energy male shout 'Okiru!'. A bright, mid-tempo electronic music track with a strong 4/4 beat starts immediately. (2) Digital 'ping' and 'shimmer' sound effects trigger as futuristic UI elements appear visually. The main male voice narrates with a slightly comedic, exaggerated tone, discussing 'awakening'. (3) A series of mechanical click sounds accompany the count-up of exercises. The BGM remains upbeat and energetic. (4) As the scene transitions to the restaurant, the sound of a chime SFX marks the change. The voice of a second male speaker (the staff) is heard with a polite, service-oriented inflection. (5) The sound design shifts to include crisp, high-frequency sizzling noises as meat hits the grill. There are percussive chopping sounds as the steak is sliced. (6) A celebratory digital 'fanfare' SFX triggers when a reward is displayed. The narrator's voice becomes more relaxed and melodic as he describes the flavor of the food, accompanied by wet 'smacking' and swallowing sounds. (7) The video ends with a rapid montage where the speech density increases, and the BGM swells in volume before a final hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Training Montage -> Restaurant Mission -> Reward Consumption -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a gamified 'leveling up' narrative to promote the BBQ restaurant '肉次方'. It draws on anime/gaming tropes (awakening, quest logs, rewards) to create an engaging story where the protagonist must eat high-quality meat to 'strengthen' himself, ultimately showcasing the variety and quality of the restaurant's menu.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video revolves around visiting a specific restaurant brand '肉次方' and showcasing its food, logo, and service.
